title: FoxyMoron

# FoxyMoron

FoxyMoron is a Advertising Services company. FoxyMoron is a leading independent full-funnel creative and performance digital agency and a part of the Zoo Media network. FoxyMoron employs 87 people (-13.8% YoY, -29 people) and has an annual revenue of $12M, founded in 2008. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across India, United States, and Poland.

## About

Founded in 2008, FoxyMoron is an award-winning full-funnel creative and performance digital agency.

We provide solutions to create future-ready brands on digital platforms, through an integration of content, technology, media, and data.

We have built several sustainable partnerships with leading brands across industries, including L’Oreal, Netflix, Colgate, Amazon India, Burger King, IKEA, DS Group, SanDisk, OBL Tiles, Hershey’s Group, Manyavar, ABC India, Turner International, DAMAC, PMF, Sharekhan, Gillette Venus, Braun, Uniqlo, TVS iQube, and Revital H NXT.

We are proud to be a part of the Zoo Media Network, which is India's largest independent marketing technology company, comprising several category-leading agencies. Zoo Media was founded in 2008 by Pratik Gupta and Suveer Bajaj, with the vision of being the preferred ‘network of choice’ for leading brands in India and the world. Zoo Media has over 600 employees distributed across offices in Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, New York City, and Dubai.

To collaborate with us, please email us at bd@zoomedia.in
